page_title: NAP 3-1 ATA | Napoli v Atalanta 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
90+3' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Eljif Elmas (Napoli).

90+3' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

87' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) has a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better as his effort ends wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
86' Napoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
84' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) will replace Ademola Lookman.
81' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
79' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Di Bello signals.
77' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
77' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
75' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Juan Jesus (Napoli).
75' A clumsy foul by Juan Jesus (Napoli) and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
74' Problems for Antonio Conte as Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lorenzo Lucca replaces him.
73' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
72' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) replaces Noa Lang.
69' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. David Neres will be replaced by Matteo Politano (Napoli).
69' Miguel Gutierrez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).

68' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies yards wide of the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
67' The corner from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is hurriedly cleared.
66' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Vanja Milinkovic-Savic. Atalanta earn a corner.
65' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
63' Amir Rrahmani doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Juan Jesus (Napoli) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
62' Here comes a substitution. Davide Zappacosta is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta).
62' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) receives a yellow card.
61' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
61' Poor challenge! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is penalised for tripping and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
59' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is penalised.
59' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle after Marten de Roon (Atalanta) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
57' Noa Lang (Napoli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
56' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' 3 - 1 Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom right corner. What a brilliant finish!

52' Nice move, nice attempt! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
51' A crossfield pass from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
49' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Marco Carnesecchi stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
47' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) brings an opponent down and Marco Di Bello interrupts the game. A free kick to Napoli.
47' The resulting corner from David Neres (Napoli) is cleared.
46' Half-time substitution. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) will not participate anymore and Gianluca Scamacca is coming on.
46' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Odilon Kossounou comes on the pitch for Honest Ahanor (Atalanta).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' 3 - 0 Goal! Giovanni Di Lorenzo plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Noa Lang (Napoli), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 3:0.

44' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
43' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.
38' 2 - 0 David Neres (Napoli) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
36' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
35' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.

32' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
32' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
31' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
29' Scott McTominay (Napoli) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
29' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
28' The foul by David Neres (Napoli) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Atalanta will take a free kick.
27' Ederson (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
24' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
20' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) brings his opponent down. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
17' 1 - 0 David Neres (Napoli) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom left corner.
16' Noa Lang (Napoli) sends a long ball in, but Marco Carnesecchi comfortably gathers the ball.
14' Dangerous play by Isak Hien (Atalanta). Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli earn a free kick.
11' The resulting corner from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) comes to nothing.
10' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
8' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.

4' Isak Hien (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Napoli are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) takes a short corner kick.
3' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
2' Noa Lang (Napoli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Atalanta will kick the game off.
Marco Di Bello was nominated as the referee for this game.
